His shoulders, fingers, facial muscles and eyelids genuinely act, the tea steam curls and sleeve creases respond. Camera makes a short sharp push toward his face then settles; no cuts. A quick satisfied small smile finishes gesture. Clear anticipation, action and reaction, genuine eye blink, eyebrow, shoulder, hair and sleeve movement, no frozen expression. Camera tracks her pointing hand slightly then returns to eyes, one controlled move. Preserve the hand-painted mature game-art look, not live action or 3D, exact woman face and clothing, subtle charcoal slate surroundings with warm skin. No dialogue or text.
